components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.55rem 1rem; background: var(--foreground, #161614); color: var(--background, #efeee9); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent, #1f5c45); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #1f5c45); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Project status; Ongoing is pale green with a pulsing dot, others are stone with a static dot.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.25rem 0.65rem; background: var(--surface, #e4e2db); color: var(--muted, #6e6c66); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-dot { position: relative; width: 0.375rem; height: 0.375rem; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-tag-live { background: var(--accent-soft, #cfe3d6); color: var(--accent, #1f5c45); } .ds-tag-live .ds-dot { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; } .ds-tag-live .ds-dot::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; background: currentColor; animation: ds-ping 1.8s cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-ping { 75%, 100% { transform: scale(2.4); opacity: 0; } }

components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; max-width: 22rem; } .ds-field-label { color: var(--muted, #6e6c66); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d6d4cc); background: var(--background, #efeee9); color: var(--foreground, #161614); padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(110 108 102 / 0.7); } .ds-input:focus, .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent, #1f5c45); }

narrative.overview:
The site reads like a working researcher's notebook: stone-coloured paper, green ink, hard ruled lines, and every entry indexed. Sections open with a parenthesised mono index such as `(01)`, figures carry `Fig. 01` captions, and projects sit in a ledger rather than a grid of cards. The structure is technical and exact; the character comes from craft details that reward attention, like the self-portrait drawn in binary digits, lines that draw themselves out of the portrait, and a contact letter that folds into a paper plane.

The mood is technical, crafted, and playful. Heavy, tight sans display type carries the confidence, and single italic serif words in green ink add warmth, as if annotated by hand. Playfulness lives in motion and small interactions, never in colour noise or decoration: the palette stays to one ink green on stone, and the layout stays on a strict 12-column grid.

This is explicitly not a template developer portfolio. No dark-mode neon gradients, glassmorphism, tech-logo walls, or skill-percentage bars.
keyCharacteristics: Stone paper background with near-black ink and a single ink-green accent.
Heavy Inter Tight display (800, line-height 0.92) with italic Instrument Serif accent words.
Small uppercase JetBrains Mono labels for indexes, nav, captions, and tags.
Hard 1px ink rules divide sections; soft pencil lines divide rows.
Fully rounded pill buttons and tags; flat tonal cards.
Motion that draws, reveals, and assembles, all disabled under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: Ink Green is the only accent. Emphasis comes from green ink or a pale-green highlight, never from a second hue.

rules.name: The Data-Only Orange Rule
rules.body: Risk Orange appears only where it encodes meaning (risk, error). If it is decorating, remove it.

rules.name: The One Italic Word Rule
rules.body: A display title gets at most one italic serif word or fragment, in Ink Green. It is the annotation, not the headline.

rules.name: The Mono Scaffold Rule
rules.body: Indexes, captions, labels, and controls are always mono caps. Body copy never is.

rules.name: The Ruled Page Rule
rules.body: Major divisions are a 1px Ink rule; minor divisions are a 1px Pencil Line. No other dividers.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest. If a surface needs separation, use Stone Surface or a rule.

dos: **Do** keep Ink Green (#1f5c45) as the single accent, and Pale Green (#cfe3d6) only as a highlight fill under dark text.
**Do** open sections with an Ink rule and a parenthesised mono index such as `(01)`.
**Do** caption figures and demos in mono caps (`Fig. 01 — …`).
**Do** end page titles with the green full-stop dot and use at most one italic serif word per title.
**Do** use pills for every button, tag, and nav link; cards at 16px radius.
**Do** make motion draw, reveal, or assemble content, and disable it fully under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** switch wide composited scenes to stacked layouts below 768px.
donts: **Don't** build a template developer portfolio look: no dark-mode neon gradients, glassmorphism, tech-logo walls, or skill-percentage bars.
**Don't** add a second accent hue; Risk Orange (#d9480f) is for risk data and errors only.
**Don't** put shadows on surfaces at rest.
**Don't** set body copy in mono caps or labels in the serif.
**Don't** hard-code copy in components; it lives in `content/*.ts`.
